johnson_cook_damage.sentinel_policy: absolute value at or above 1e29 is unavailable with a reason, never zero

d3part_history_variables.acceptance: identify channels by returned semantics and cross-checks; never infer the damage channel from array position alone

intfor.solver_evidence: Warning 20340 (STR+340): binary interface force data is unavailable for eroding contact types - interface #1

ncforc.evidence_boundary: Job 72397333 returned no NCFORC artifact, but Warning 20340 applies specifically to binary INTFOR and does not prove NCFORC is unsupported

direct_contact.sleout_boundary: interface energy only; never substitute for pressure, gap, penetration, or nodal interface force

d3part_keyword.intent: override D3PART content with six solid history variables while retaining documented defaults for all other fields

capture_ledger.failure_policy: mark primary QoI unavailable; never replace unavailable with zero

recanary_comparison.scope: numerical repeatability diagnostic only; not physical validation or response admission

claim_boundary: R06j partially suppressed fragment deletion but left exactly 35 negative-volume-driven fragment deletions.
R06k changes only PSFAIL from 0 to plate-only set 910001, excluding fragment part 2002 from the ERODING-contact negative-volume criterion.
Fragment MAT_015 EROD remains 1 and the contact formulation remains ERODING_SINGLE_SURFACE.
The model continues to start from the same post-explosion fragment state.
Any R06k result is mechanism evidence only and cannot authorize engine fitting, damage-tree fitting or dataset admission.

explosion_instant_start_policy.r06h_rule: initial geometry, velocity and all other state remain byte-equivalent to Job 72639935
explosion_instant_start_policy.future_full_warhead_rule: A full-warhead high-fidelity model may start at explosion time only after the mapped mass, momentum, energy, fragment-state and boundary-state transfer is frozen and audited.

timestep_terminal_refinement.single_factor_rule: The terminal refinement deck may differ from the returned TSSFAC=0.1 deck only in TITLE and CONTROL_TIMESTEP field 2 TSSFAC, 0.1 to 0.05.

terminal_stop_rule.if_all_gates_and_response_availability_p: Select TSSFAC=0.05 as the local production candidate, then audit whether the 2000 m/s control may be released.
terminal_stop_rule.if_diagnostic_values_agree_but_response_: Stop timestep halving and pivot to fragment deletion, material failure and contact diagnostics.
terminal_stop_rule.if_any_comparison_gate_fails: Stop timestep halving and classify the current control as numerically/model-form unstable.

fragment_erosion_isolation.single_factor_rule: The R06j deck may differ from the returned R06i deck only in TITLE and fragment material MAT_015 Card 4 field 3 EROD, 0 to 1. Plate EROD remains 0.

solver_semantics.erod_0: element erosion is allowed after failure (default)
solver_semantics.erod_nonzero: the failed element is not eroded; its deviatoric stresses are set to zero after failure
solver_semantics.source: ANSYS LS-DYNA Materials Manual R14, MAT_015 Card 4 EROD

interpretation_rules.deletion_suppressed_with_failure_damage_: supports fragment failure erosion as the cause of the upstream deletion mechanism only
interpretation_rules.negative_volume_or_solver_failure: supports numerical dependence on erosion but does not validate the material or contact model
interpretation_rules.primary_qoi_policy: never promote EROD=1 response values to physical labels, calibration targets or reference data

fragment_negative_volume_isolation.single_factor_rule: The R06k deck may differ from returned R06j only in TITLE and CONTROL_SOLID Card 1 field 5 PSFAIL, 0 to plate-only part set 910001.

solver_semantics.eroding_contact_side_effect: ERODING contact automatically activates a negative-volume failure criterion for solid elements
solver_semantics.psfail_scope: A nonzero PSFAIL part-set ID restricts that criterion to solids in the named part set
solver_semantics.treatment_effect: PSFAIL=910001 keeps the criterion on plate part 1002 and excludes fragment part 2002
solver_semantics.source: Ansys LS-DYNA Explicit Technical Guide, ERODING contact and PSFAIL guidance

interpretation_rules.fragment_deletion_removed_but_distortion: supports negative-volume erosion as the remaining deletion path and demonstrates that simple deletion suppression is not a production remedy
interpretation_rules.fragment_deletion_persists: refutes exclusive attribution and requires another deletion-path audit
interpretation_rules.normal_completion_without_fragment_delet: still does not establish physical validity because the treatment suppresses a numerical failure criterion
interpretation_rules.primary_qoi_policy: never promote PSFAIL-isolation response values to physical labels, calibration targets or reference data
